outline: 本課程內容包括控制閥、控制器之介紹，程序動態應答分析，閉還路控制系統分析，控制器調諧，頻率應答分析及串級控制系統之介紹。
schedule:
1.	基本微積分複習 (1st week)
2.	拉普拉士變換 (2nd week)
3.	一階系統 (3rd-4 th weeks)
4.	二階系統 (5th-6th weeks)
5.	回授控制系統 (7th-8th weeks)
6.	期中考 (9th week)
7.	控制器與控制閥 (10th-11th week)
8.	穩定性與根軌跡 (12th-13th week)
9.	頻率應答 (14th-15th weeks )
10.	控制系統之設計 (16th weeks)
11.	非線性系統 (17th week)
12.	期末考 (18th week)
assessment:
Grading: Usual Appearance 20%, Middle examination 40%, Final examination 40%
Note：There will be severe penalty for being late or not attending the class. The maximum penalty will be the flunk at the end of semester.
